origins.section: The Source Is Read When the Terminal Operation Runs, and Must Not Change Under It
The Source Is Read When the Terminal Operation Runs, and Must Not Change Under It
Each Element Goes Through the Whole Pipeline Before the Next, and Short-Circuiting Stops the Pulling
A Stream Can Be Consumed Once, So Keep a Supplier, Not the Stream

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-credit-note-during-mailing: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-credit-note-during-mailing: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-credit-note-during-mailing: The page decides option a. Lines 221-232 show the same shape (an ArrayList, an add inside map, then forEach): every original element is processed and then ConcurrentModificationException is thrown. Lines 236-237 say that for forEach the spliterator compares the modification count once, after the last element, and the Reference table at line 360 says the same.
recorded.prompt:q-job-appended-before-tolist: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-job-appended-before-tolist: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-job-appended-before-tolist: The page decides option a. Lines 193-196 and 205 show an element added after stream() but before toList() appearing in the result. Lines 209-211 explain that ArrayList's spliterator is late-binding and binds at the first traversal, and the Reference table at line 359 confirms it.
recorded.prompt:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst: The page decides option a. Lines 82-84 say the terminal operation pulls one element and pushes it through every stage before it pulls the next, and the trace at lines 74-78 shows the stages interleaving. Lines 86, 97 and 104, and line 338 of the Reference table, show that filter(...).findFirst() stops at the first match: the predicate was checked 300 times for a match at element 300.
recorded.prompt:q-recent-orders-two-filters: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recent-orders-two-filters: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recent-orders-two-filters: The page decides option a. Lines 117-119 say a second operation that builds on the same Stream object throws, intermediate ones included, before anything has run. Lines 122-128 show a second filter on the same base stream throwing, and line 349 confirms it. Lines 135-136 say a method that returns a stream kept in a field fails the same way for its second caller.

recorded.prompt:q-credit-note-during-mailing:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-credit-note-during-mailing:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-credit-note-during-mailing:b: The page refutes b. Line 235 says the retry was never shipped, and line 232 shows the run ending in ConcurrentModificationException. Lines 216-217 call a change during the terminal operation interference that must never happen.
recorded.prompt:q-credit-note-during-mailing:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-credit-note-during-mailing:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-credit-note-during-mailing:c: The page refutes c. Line 235 says the add succeeded and the exception came after all four orders had shipped, so add() refused nothing and the run did not stop early. Line 232 shows the orders list now holding o-2-retry.
recorded.prompt:q-credit-note-during-mailing:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-credit-note-during-mailing:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-credit-note-during-mailing:d: The page refutes d. Lines 236-238 say the check after each element belongs to short-circuiting operations, while forEach compares once, after the last element. Lines 360-361 of the Reference table make the same split.
recorded.prompt:q-job-appended-before-tolist:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-job-appended-before-tolist:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-job-appended-before-tolist:b: The page refutes b's reason. Lines 216-217 and line 360 say that changing the source while the terminal operation runs is interference and ends in ConcurrentModificationException, so an ArrayList may not be appended to at any point while a stream over it runs.
recorded.prompt:q-job-appended-before-tolist:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-job-appended-before-tolist:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-job-appended-before-tolist:c: The page refutes c. Lines 205 and 209-211 show that an ArrayList stream sees the later add and copies nothing when stream() is called. Lines 211-212 and 206 give the snapshot behaviour to CopyOnWriteArrayList only.
recorded.prompt:q-job-appended-before-tolist:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-job-appended-before-tolist:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-job-appended-before-tolist:d: The page refutes d. Line 205 shows a change made before the terminal operation succeeding and being seen, with no exception, and line 359 confirms it.
recorded.prompt:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:b: The page refutes b. Lines 74-78 show map running for A-1 before filter sees B-7, and line 84 says no list is built between the stages, so map does not load every key before the filter sees the first value.
recorded.prompt:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:c: The page refutes c. Lines 97 and 338 show the upstream stage running for every element up to the first match (checks=300, not 1), and lines 82-83 say each element pulled goes through every stage, so the first two keys are loaded too.
recorded.prompt:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cache-loads-before-findfirst:d: The page refutes d. Lines 97 and 104 show findFirst stopping as soon as it has its answer, with no need to see later elements. Line 341 shows that reading every element happens only when the pipeline collects or counts first.
recorded.prompt:q-recent-orders-two-filters:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recent-orders-two-filters:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recent-orders-two-filters:b: The page refutes b. Lines 117-119 say the check is stricter than one terminal operation, and line 124 shows the second filter throwing before any terminal operation has run.
recorded.prompt:q-recent-orders-two-filters:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recent-orders-two-filters:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recent-orders-two-filters:c: The page refutes c. Lines 33-34 say a field reads like a view but a Stream is a one-shot pipeline. Lines 135-136 say a method returning a stream it keeps in a field fails for its second caller, so recent() does not hand out anything fresh.
recorded.prompt:q-recent-orders-two-filters:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recent-orders-two-filters:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recent-orders-two-filters:d: The page refutes d. Lines 52-56 show that building a pipeline runs nothing and that the Stream holds a chain, not elements. The exception comes earlier, at the second filter (lines 122-128), so late.count() is never reached.
